name: The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
positioning: A lakeside resort on the shores of Lake Las Vegas in Henderson, minutes from the Las Vegas Strip, with lake-view rooms, a two-level pool and an on-site spa
best_for: Travelers who want a calm lakeside base near Las Vegas rather than a Strip hotel
Golfers and families who want pools, mini-golf and a nearby Jack Nicklaus course

facts.text: The resort is on Lake Las Vegas, minutes from the Las Vegas Strip.
Guest rooms and suites have lake views.
Accommodation options include suites and Casbah Villas.
The resort has the two-level Nuala Pool.
A whirlpool sits next to the upper-level pool.
By the lower-level pool there is a basketball court and a mini-golf area.
Ah Spa by Ageless Humans is on site.
Marssa Restaurant serves Certified Angus Beef and Wagyu steaks with lake and mountain views.
The hotel is near Lake Mead National Recreation Area.

highlights.text: The upper-level pool has views of the lake and beach, with private cabanas to rent.
The property sits on the shores of Lake Las Vegas in Henderson, with a desert-lakeside atmosphere.
Guests can play Reflection Bay Golf Club, a Jack Nicklaus Signature Design course with lake and canyon views.

considerations.text: The resort is in Henderson on Lake Las Vegas, not on the Strip; WhataHotel notes guests need transportation to reach the Strip.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and entertainment on site.
